name: Serve
overview: The Scriptures clearly teach that true service is rooted in wholehearted devotion to God rather than divided loyalties, as no one can serve two masters (Matthew 6:24). Jesus exemplifies servant leadership by coming not to be served but to serve others and give His life as a ransom (Matthew 20:28; Mark 10:45). Genuine greatness in the kingdom of God is marked by humility and a willingness to be a servant to all (Matthew 23:11; Mark 9:35). Those who serve Christ faithfully are called to follow Him closely and are promised honor from the Father (John 12:26).
